title: Human Resource Recruiter
description:
Job Title Talent Acquisition Executive / Specialist 
 Location - Gandhinagar, Gujarat 
 Experience - 1 to 5 Years 
 Department - Human Resources 
 Job Summary We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Talent Acquisition professional to join our HR team. The candidate will be responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment process, sourcing qualified candidates, coordinating interviews, and ensuring a smooth hiring experience for both candidates and internal stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end recruitment activities from sourcing to offer and joining. Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media, and other recruitment channels. Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate assessments. Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers and candidates. Maintain and update candidate databases and recruitment trackers. Manage candidate communication throughout the recruitment process. Negotiate offers and coordinate the offer-to-joining process. Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future hiring requirements. Work closely with department heads and hiring managers to understand manpower requirements. Ensure timely closure of open positions as per hiring targets. Maintain recruitment MIS and prepare regular hiring reports. Support employer branding and other talent acquisition initiatives. Required Skills Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Good understanding of recruitment and talent acquisition processes. Hands-on experience with job portals and LinkedIn sourcing. Strong candidate screening and interviewing skills. Good negotiation and stakeholder-management abilities. Ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Proficiency in MS Excel and basic HR tools/ATS. Qualification Graduate or Postgraduate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA/PGDM in HR will be an added advantage. Key Performance Indicators Timely closure of open positions. Quality and relevance of candidate profiles. Offer-to-joining ratio. Time-to-hire. Candidate experience. Recruitment pipeline and hiring target achievement.

Key Skills: End to End Recruitment,Hiring,Talent Acquisition,Acquisition,End,End To End,Human resource management,Resource
